listing.name: The Interwars Alliance v0.2a [The Hegemony Haters]
listing.summary: Adds a new faction with a militaristic ideology, heavy armor-focused ships, and unique mechanics like minefield-generating B2s.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with a militaristic ideology, heavy armor-focused ships, and unique mechanics like minefield-generating B2s.

description:
Hello ! After a long time, pain and misery, i finally present my own faction mod that will contain most of my best creations (And moustrous ones).

PATCHNOTE 0.2b : (I don't think it'll be safe to update, might break savegames)

- The B2's now are BOMBING properly (A.K.A they have minefield generator, so they now have a massive MEME potential), they're not balanced, especially if you have more than one in your fleet, but the Interwars Alliance was NEVER MEANT to play fair.

- Added the Kyte V2 (Which is just ... A "Capital" Kyte).

- Some readjustment to stats and built-in components + active systems.

- Fixed some issues with code.

DESCRIPTION / LORE

First of all, you can consider this faction like it was a player faction that got fed up with the Hegemony and their annoying AI Inspections, raids, and never-ending warmongering.

They've been at war with the Hegemony since their birth and will stop at nothing to ensure that their mortal enemy completely disappear from the sector without a trace. Anyone who's ready to help them make this dream into a reality will be rewarded handsomely !

While being a technocratic and extremely militaristic faction, they didn't choose this path because they wanted to, but because they were forced to ...

« Anyone who desire peace will need to prepare for war, it is a shame that we were not wise enough for what was to come in the first place. »

Throughout their development, the Interwars Alliance faced a lot of setbacks, but grew into a force that, now, need to be accounted with in the sector.

It is important to note that this faction will NEVER declare opportunistic wars or open the hostilities with any factions willingly, BUT will fight to the death and put everything on the line to make sure that the aggressor disappear forever from their vicinity.

At the time they were developing their own ships and weapons to better fight against the Hegemony's fleets, they created ties with the Persean League and Tri-tachion to the point their relationships with those two factions became quite amicable (Can still be declared war on by the said factions, really depends on how your sector plays out).

For their doctrine in terms of fleet ... They rely mostly on massive ships with extremely heavy armor and weaponry. It is said that nothing in the sector can rival their fire-power and defensive capabilities, sacrificing the speed for pure raw-power.

BUT ! Do not be mistaken, they know of their ships weaknesses and developed countermeasures to make sure no one would be able to defeat them in any situation possible.

While being heavy armored and equipped with plenty of fire-power, most of their bigger ships also carry fighters for support or offensive operations.

PS : For people who love to read lore, the entire development of the Interwars Alliance's ships and military is detailed in the descriptions.

THE SHIPS / ARMADA

Spoiler

Frigates :

Helisk and Tyrian.

Those two little frigates were the first ever vessels to be created by the engineers of the Interwars Alliance. While being both fragile, they had their role in the development of the faction's military expertise.

The Helisk is also not to be underestimated because of its hammer-barrages that still remain extremely violent despite bigger alternatives existing for a replacement.

Jounka

Following the development of their own technologies, the Jounka was born to be a well rounded and simple destroyer.

Zoma

First vessel to have high defensive capabilities, its fire-power can be considered tame compared to the ships that were developed after him, but it still is a wall that can be hard to break.

Overquest

Considered the first part of multiple experiments with the Conquest Battle-cruiser, this one was stripped of most of its base functions to receive more mobility and a second large missile mount. Its performance are considered above the base Conquest that it was built-upon.

Overquest MKC (Mark Carrier)

Second version of the Overquest project, this version carry fighters while keeping most of its fire-power and mobility. This Conquest modification was the first ever step that paved the way towards the biggest Interwars Alliance ships.

Overquest MKT (Mark Transport)

Wondered what would have happened if a freighter received an upgrade, heavy armor and an armament worthy of a warship of the same size ? That's what some engineers asked themselves before starting to work on this variant.

Vanitor

One of the first armored carrier ship of the Interwars Alliance. While its fire-power could be considered average at best, its survivability generally provide this ship enough time to retreat to a safer position or quit the battle before getting destroyed.

Conquarrier

Aimed to be a full fledged carrier without much of its fire-power left, the Conquarrier can still be seen in some military fleets of the Interwars Alliance.

Vanitor MKT (Mark Transport)

Armored freighter to the extreme.

Vanitor MKH (Mark Heavy)

Even heavier than its predecessor with spaced-armor and defensive capabilities that are over the charts, it'll take a lot of efforts to bring down this carrier.

Stercruser

Developed to be the Onslaught Slaughterer, everything about this monstrous capital ship was designed to destroy its counter-part in a face-to-face battle without sustaining any serious damages.

Stercruser MK2 (Mark 2)

Upgraded version of the Stercruser, way stronger and sturdier.

Valkyrion MKS (Mark Support)

First of the two iterations of the Valkyrion, it was developed to be a mobile fortress, carrier and command center that was supposed to stay behind to support the attacking fleets, but it was quickly discovered that its fire-power and sturdiness were enough to be engaged in the front-lines.

A massive carrier that packs enough punch to slaughter entire fleets on its own in the hands of a skilled Capitain or Officer.

Valkyrion MKA (Mark Assault)

The beast you wish to never encounter and the dream vessel for any competent and ambitious Interwars Alliance's Captain.

[close]

This faction will be developed slowly and steadily with a high risk of hiatus, BUT it will never be left in the dust. I'll always come back to it !

DOWNLOAD

https://drive.google.com/file/d/12gTLaDRW3rud2anmogsjWVkU50_YML1p/view?usp=sharing

BONUS

Already available to find/buy and potential fly !

Wait ... Is that a collaboration with Tri-tachion ? Who knows ...

CREDITS :

- Bigbeans (Free Sprites)
- Me (Everything else)

Thanks to the people of the Galatia Academy discord who helped me put this faction together !

Introduces a variety of new ships, including modified versions of existing designs and new capital-class vessels, with unique mechanics like minefield generation. The faction is designed to be aggressive in defense but avoids initiating wars, relying on strong fleet doctrines and support from allied factions.
